cases.refreshed: Our library volunteer and experienced stamp collector from San Jose Stamp Club invites you to attend a meeting to learn about the fun and educational opportunities with collecting stamps. Meetings are free to attend and held on the 1st Wednesday of the month at 6:45 PM in the Pearl Ave Branch Library Community Room. Discover the fun of collecting stamps of a country you love or a topic that excites you. Meetings typically feature a presentation by an experienced collector for less experienced collectors. Free and open to everyone. No registration is required. No promotions, donations, fundraising, or sales are allowed. No membership fee is required to attend the meeting.

events.title: Crafter Dark: DIY eco friendly wrapping paper

cases.refreshed: This event happens on the third Wednesday of every month. This month we are focusing on eco friendly options for wrapping paper. This craft uses paper, paint, and pens. As this craft involves paint, come ready to get a little messy. All supplies and tools are provided by the library. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3947, or email us at ask@lib.sccgov.org.
